verdict.rationale: Reducto's docs claim strong structured parsing with layout, tables, and formatting handling (reducto-docs-1, reducto-docs-14, reducto-docs-13) and even an 'agentic modes' feature for complex layouts, but community evidence includes a hands-on report that Reducto 'did struggle with long documents' (300+ page financial PDFs) versus a competitor, and a competitor's founder relaying that others find a rival 'better at just getting data out of PDFs accurately' (reducto-comm-4, reducto-comm-7). Reducto's own founder acknowledges a cost/latency tradeoff for their most accurate mode (reducto-comm-8), reinforcing that base parsing accuracy on complex real-world docs isn't uniformly strong. Missing for 10: independent benchmark data on multi-column/footnote ordering accuracy, and resolution of the long-document struggle reported by users.
